title: ISO 27001 compliance software compared
content_html:
This ISO 27001 compliance software comparison looks at two tools for ISO 27001 (the international standard for managing information security). Vanta is a live platform that automates compliance work for ISO 27001 and other frameworks. Assure, from Upward Technologies, handles ISO 27001 document control and is in beta. Vanta suits teams that need a working platform today.

This page covers only products whose facts could be checked against their own websites. Other ISO 27001 tools exist. Check their websites before you decide.

No software gives you the certificate. An external audit does that. These tools help you prepare the work the audit looks at.

Vanta

Vanta is a compliance platform. According to its website (read November 2026), it automates the work of getting certified for ISO 27001, GDPR (the EU data protection rules) and other frameworks.

What its website says it does:

  • Its integrations pull data automatically from more than 400 tools.
  • Its API lets you build your own integrations and workflows.
  • It gathers evidence and monitors systems continuously.
  • Its Trust Center lets you show customers your compliance status and documents.
  • Its Questionnaire Automation fills in answers to security questionnaires.
  • Its Third Party Risk Management product handles supplier onboarding and security reviews in one place.

Who it is for: Vanta's website lists solutions for startups and for enterprises. Its pricing page says thousands of customers use it. It suits teams that need more than one framework and want evidence collected from many cloud tools.

Its genuine strength: breadth. One platform covers several frameworks, a large set of integrations and the work around an audit, such as questionnaires and supplier reviews. If that is what you need today, Vanta is the better choice of the two on this page.

Source: Vanta's website

Assure (by Upward Technologies)

Assure is ISO 27001 document control software from Upward Technologies (upwardtech.nl), a Dutch software company in Breda. Assure is in beta. This page states no other functions for it.

Who it is for: teams whose main ISO 27001 need is keeping their documents under control.

Be aware: a beta product can still change. If you need evidence collected from many tools, more than one framework or supplier reviews, Assure is not described as doing that. Pick a platform that is.

For context, Upward Technologies is working toward ISO 27001 certification itself. According to upwardtech.nl, that certification is in progress, not held.

How to choose

Start with what the audit needs from you, not with the tool.

  • One framework or several? If customers ask for proof under more than one framework, a multi-framework platform such as Vanta fits better.
  • Documents or evidence? Some teams mostly need policies and procedures that are versioned, approved and easy to find. Others need proof pulled from their cloud tools. Pick a tool for the one you actually have.
  • How many tools hold your evidence? The more systems you run, the more integrations matter.
  • Live or beta? A beta product can suit a team that is happy to give feedback. A team with an audit date close by usually wants a live product.
  • Does anything off the shelf fit your process? If none of these tools fits how your team works, custom software is an option. This guide on how to choose custom software development covers that choice.

For a broader look at the criteria, read what to look for in the best ISO 27001 compliance software.

ISO 27001 compliance software comparison: how the tools were compared

  • Verified facts only. Each claim comes from the product's own website, with the month it was read.
  • Status. Whether you can use the product in full today or only in beta.
  • Focus. What the product is built to do, in its maker's words.
  • Frameworks. Which standards the maker names.
  • Integrations. What the maker states about connecting to other tools.
  • Fit. Which reader situation each product suits, including when the other one is the better pick.
